summary: Added /goal_github_push Telegram command to src/telegram/goal-commands.ts with three changes: (1) added command spec to GOAL_COMMAND_SPECS array, (2) added GOAL_GITHUB_PUSH_USAGE constant, (3) added handler following the goal_plan_autocheck pattern — authAndResolve guard, no-arg shows current on/off status, on/off arg toggles cfg.goal.githubPush.enabled via loadConfig/writeConfigFile, invalid arg shows usage, resolveChannelConfigWrites check before writing. pnpm build and pnpm lint both pass with zero errors.
